notes: REWRITE of draft #38: written fresh; no D/T or CLR/OD wrinkle thresholds (readers are sent to die maker charts). Direct page fetches were blocked, so every Rogue Fab, The Fabricator, Tube Form Solutions and Pro-Tools fact came from WebSearch result summaries of those maker/trade pages; please spot-check: (1) Rogue Fab bend-quality page: four causes, clamp fix with 220-grit/emery cloth and lacquer thinner/acetone, rear pressure-die hole marked 'HD, never use on .120 wall or thinner'; (2) Rogue Fab TWR page: 10.0% vs 6.4% deformation (vendor test); (3) Pro-Tools 302/Portabender die page: 1" x 3" CLR die .065 min DOM, .083 recommended for ERW; (4) The Fabricator troubleshooting claims were summarised across several articles (inconsistent wrinkles = clamp slip; continuous wrinkles = low pressure-die force; end-of-bend wrinkles = wiper; flat outside = too much pressure-die force; never set wiper at/past tangent); (5) Fabricator mandrel chart example 2 x .065 on 4 CLR -> two-ball mandrel with wiper (from the kit fact-check notes). Primary keyword is used verbatim only in the intro (as a quoted search phrase); title and H2 use the comma form for readability. Ovality worked example uses illustrative caliper readings.
